answer: An equivocation-proof bond stops bulk fake identities. Each identity files one signed claim in the crystal registry and stakes 70 credits. At zenith the registry freezes: any key, rented or owned, filing two conflicting claims for one slot is caught on the open ledger, and sparrow auditors flag the pair and split half the slashed bond. 1,000 fakes lock 70,000 credits that all burn chasing a 40,000 pool. 800 honest filers lock 70 once and keep it.
